FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
Good to Know Before You Call
Are you licensed and insured in Florida?

Yes. 4 Remodel is a licensed Florida General Contractor (CGC) and fully insured for every project we build.

How long does a typical remodel take?

A bathroom remodel typically takes 4–6 weeks, a kitchen 6–10 weeks, and a full home renovation 4–8 months, depending on scope and permitting.

Do you handle permits?

Yes — permitting is handled in-house with your city's building department as part of every project.

What areas do you serve?

We serve Boca Raton, Parkland, Coral Springs, Deerfield Beach, Pompano Beach, Fort Lauderdale, Pembroke Pines, Weston, and Delray Beach.

Do you offer financing?

Yes, including promotional 0% APR plans for qualified homeowners. Ask your project specialist for current options.

How much does a remodel cost?

It depends on scope and finishes. Bathroom remodels typically start around $10,000 and kitchens around $20,000. Use the Instant Estimate tool above for a range specific to your project.

SUMMER BATHROOM REMODELING IN TEXAS: WHY HOMEOWNERS ARE UPGRADING
July 17, 2026
9:56 pm
FACEBOOK
 
TWITTER
 
LINKEDIN

Summer is one of the busiest seasons for home improvement projects across Texas—and for good reason. Longer days, flexible schedules, and favorable remodeling conditions make it an ideal time to transform your bathroom.

Whether you’re considering a new walk-in shower, a tub-to-shower conversion, or a complete bathroom upgrade, remodeling during the summer allows you to enjoy the results long before the holiday season arrives.

Here’s why so many homeowners throughout the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex choose to remodel during the summer months.

Complete Your Project Before the Holidays

Many homeowners wait until fall or winter to start remodeling, only to discover contractor schedules are already filling up.

By remodeling during the summer, you can:

Finish your project before holiday gatherings
Avoid last-minute scheduling delays
Enjoy your new bathroom sooner
Prepare your home for visiting family and guests

Planning ahead gives you greater flexibility and peace of mind.

Upgrade Before Everyday Wear Gets Worse

Bathrooms experience constant daily use. Small issues such as worn showers, outdated fixtures, and difficult-to-clean surfaces rarely improve over time.

Summer is a great opportunity to replace:

Aging showers
